summary: Tested multi-step wizard refactoring for Asset, Liability, and Investment modules. All 3-step flows (type-selection → details → deep-details) work correctly. Backend API save-step endpoints (steps 3, 4, 5) correctly persist data including deep fields. Frontend navigation and UI elements verified.

asset_wizard_step1.details: 6 asset type cards (Bank Balance, Property/Land, Gold/Jewellery, Vehicle, Equipment, Other) displayed correctly. Clicking card auto-navigates to step 2. 'I don't have any assets' skip button works.

asset_wizard_step2.details: Name and value inputs visible, 'Add another asset' button works, Continue button navigates to step 3

asset_wizard_step3.details: Purchase date and growth rate fields visible, 'Save & Done' button completes module in module mode

liability_wizard_step1.details: 6 loan type cards (Home Loan, Car Loan, Personal Loan, Education Loan, Credit Card Debt, Other) displayed. 'I'm debt free!' skip button works.

liability_wizard_step2.details: Loan name, outstanding principal, and EMI inputs visible

liability_wizard_step3.details: Interest rate, tenure, and day-of-month EMI grid selector (1-28) visible

investment_wizard_step1.details: 6 investment type cards (Mutual Funds/SIP, Stocks, FD, PPF/NPS, Gold/SGB, Crypto) displayed. 'Not yet' skip button works.

investment_wizard_step2.details: Investment name and amount inputs visible

investment_wizard_step3.details: Frequency selector (Monthly/Quarterly/One-time) buttons, start date, expected returns fields visible

module_mode_navigation.details: /onboarding?module=assets starts at asset-type step, /onboarding?module=liabilities starts at liability-type, /onboarding?module=investments starts at invest-type. Module mode shows 'Save & Done' button and returns to grid on completion.

backend_save_step_3_assets.details: POST /api/onboarding/save-step with step=3 correctly saves assets with deep fields (purchaseDate, growthRate)

backend_save_step_4_liabilities.details: POST /api/onboarding/save-step with step=4 correctly saves loans with deep fields (tenure, nextDueDate)

backend_save_step_5_investments.details: POST /api/onboarding/save-step with step=5 correctly saves investments with deep fields (frequency, startDate, growthRate)

critical_code_review_comments: All data-testid attributes are properly set for testing
Module mode correctly shows 'Save & Done' instead of 'Continue' button
Skip buttons ('I don't have any assets', 'I'm debt free!', 'Not yet') correctly mark modules as completed
Deep fields (purchaseDate, growthRate, tenure, nextDueDate, frequency) are saved in DB but may not all be returned by GET endpoints
seed_data_creation: Test users created with pattern: test_wizard_*, Test* during pytest runs
context_for_next_testing_agent: Multi-step wizard for Asset/Liability/Investment modules verified. All 3 modules have 3 steps each (type→details→deep). Key data-testids: asset-type-card-{id}, loan-type-card-{id}, invest-type-card-{id}, wizard-asset-type, wizard-liability-type, wizard-invest-type, wizard-*-details, wizard-*-deep. Skip buttons use data-testid='skip-btn'. Continue/Save uses data-testid='next-btn'.
